subject: Milestone invoicing proposal — vendor onboarding & net-term hybrid
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@paymentsco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding & invoicing cadence — PaymentsCo

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. As we start the vendor setup for PaymentsCo, a couple of asks from our side on billing cadence: our standard commercial terms are Net60, but we can be flexible if Redwood needs earlier remittance.

To speed PO activation and reduce administrative overhead, we propose a milestone (hybrid) invoicing approach for the first 3 months: 20% on PO activation, 60% on delivery acceptance, and 20% 30 days after acceptance. If Redwood can offer an early-pay incentive (we usually accept 1% for payment within 10 days), we can agree to shorten the net window on milestone invoices.

Attached are our vendor onboarding form and W9. Let me know what your AP and procurement need to complete setup and trigger the PO.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships, PaymentsCo
elena@paymentsco.com
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: W9_PaymentsCo.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@paymentsco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding & invoicing cadence — PaymentsCo

Elena — thanks for the note and the docs. Looping in Aditya (sales) and Ben (finance) so we can align on PO flow and early-pay options.

High level proposal from Redwood procurement/accounting side:
- PO activation: we can issue a preliminary PO for 25% of the first invoice to get you into our system (PO reference required for AP).
- Milestone schedule: 25% (PO activation), 55% on delivery acceptance, 20% final.
- Net terms: we prefer Net45 on milestone invoices.
- Early pay: Redwood can offer a 1.5% discount if AP receives a clean invoice with PO reference and pays within 7 calendar days of receipt (we'll confirm AP process details below).

Requirements to activate PO: signed vendor onboarding form, certificate of insurance on file, completed vendor bank details (we'll share a secure upload link), and a copy of your draft PO for our legal procurement record.

Please confirm whether PaymentsCo can accept Net45 + 1.5%/7-day early-pay for the initial contract. If that works, Ben — can you confirm AP's checklist and whether Accounting will accept milestone invoices tied to a single PO?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: certificate_request_checklist.txt (txt)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena@paymentsco.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding & invoicing cadence — PaymentsCo

Quick note from AP: milestone invoicing is fine as long as each invoice references the master PO and includes the milestone label (eg, "Milestone 1 — PO RDW-3456"). A couple of adjustments we usually ask for:
- Early-pay incentive: we can support a 2% discount if payments are made within 10 calendar days. That aligns better with our cash/tolerance windows and gives you a stronger incentive.
- For larger first-month activations we prefer an initial PO at 30% to cover ramp costs; leaves room in our system to net against subsequent milestone invoices.
- AP will only process bank details submitted through our secure portal (I will send the upload link after we have the signed onboarding form).

If PaymentsCo is okay with 30% initial PO, milestone invoices labeled and tied to one master PO, Net45 standard, and 2%/10-day early pay discount, AP can commit to that flow and aim to issue the PO within 5 business days of receiving completed documents.

Ben Carter
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: draft_PO_RDW-3456.pdf (pdf)]

- Milestone invoicing allowed (Milestone 1/2/3) — each invoice must reference PO RDW-3456 and state the milestone.
- Net45 on standard invoices.
- Early-pay incentive: 2% discount if payment is made within 10 calendar days of a clean invoice.
- Required docs to start: signed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, certificate_of_insurance.pdf, and secure bank detail upload.

Next steps: I will send a DocuSign link for the onboarding form and a secure upload link for bank details. Once we receive signed documents and COI, AP will issue the master PO (target within 5 business days).
